note: Yellowhead County campground on Bear Lake, 30 km northeast of Edson on Highway 748: sandy beach, playground, boat launch, boat and swimming docks, hand-pump water wells, and firewood from the operator. The campsites sit among spruce; the beach and launch are day use. --Claude
summary: Read the county campgrounds page: C$20 a night, 32 sites (6 pull-through, 3 tent), outhouses and hand pumps, self-registration plus a call-in reservation line run by L.O.C.K. Properties, open mid-May to September. Confirmed fees, sites (+pull-through), vault toilets; wrote booking (phone) and season (note only, no dates published). Phone is wrong (stored 780-693-2479; county gives 780-396-9185). Lakeview holds. Pin ~300 m off the loops.

WATERFRONT (stored lakeview - holds): imagery at 53.7406,-116.1618 shows the sites in spruce loops on the peninsula; the northern loop's nearest units are roughly 20-40 m from the shore but behind a continuous fringe of spruce and a reed bed, and the open beach and docks to the east are the day-use area with the access road behind them. No open apron from any site, so not lakefront; a view through the thin tree line from the north loop is consistent with lakeview. No official site photos found to confirm the view; keep lakeview (the earlier evidence string agrees).

PIN MOVE: stored 53.73911,-116.15857 sits on the access road at the entrance/day-use parking east of the loops; the campsite loops centre about 300 m WNW at 53.7406,-116.1618 (imagery; the county's Google link points at 53.74101,-116.16324, the west side of the same loops). Recommend 53.7406,-116.1618.
